payload.title: Bind H-WP-02 idempotency replay to semantic request identity

work_clay.task: Reread the latest H-WP-02 implementation and existing HWP02-IDEMPOTENCY-RACE-LOCAL-FIX work. Coalesce with that patch if possible. Ensure an idempotent replay is returned only when the existing committed event is semantically equivalent to the retry. Reject same idempotency key/event_id with changed event_type, normalized mutations or provenance as a deterministic idempotency conflict. Keep retry-local execution metadata separate from semantic identity. Execute the committed red probe and add a permanent regression against the actual module.
do_not: Do not create a second competing StateLedger lineage if the current reference ledger can be repaired.
Do not mark H-WP-02 or H1 PASS from this component fix alone.
Do not weaken idempotency uniqueness constraints.
Do not treat writer/timestamp changes alone as semantic event changes unless the adjudicated contract says they are semantic.
Do not treat ChatGPT synthetic mechanism evidence as Ubuntu project-host execution.

required: Reread current head and coalesce with HWP02-IDEMPOTENCY-RACE-LOCAL-FIX when it touches the same transaction boundary.
Identical retry remains IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY without epoch/state mutation.
Changed semantic retry using the same key/event_id is rejected deterministically.
Committed state, root identity and epoch remain unchanged after rejected changed retry.
Run hwp02_idempotency_payload_fingerprint_probe.py against the actual module on Ubuntu.
Run the concurrent race regression plus existing H-WP-02 regression/stress/crash/snapshot/tamper suites.
Write an exact local execution receipt with commit, commands, host and results.

executor_policy.reason: Ubuntu project-host execution against the actual repository module is the discriminating next step.

invalidators: A newer verified local commit for HWP02-IDEMPOTENCY-RACE-LOCAL-FIX already adds equivalent semantic fingerprint validation and passes this red probe plus full H-WP-02 regressions.
The current H-WP-02 lineage is superseded by a different adjudicated implementation.
